label: Fitting a characterization line
subgoals: Compute the means of load and delay
Divide the cross-deviation sum by the load deviation sum for the slope
Recover the intercept from the means and the slope

label: Prediction and extrapolation
subgoals: Evaluate the fitted line at the query point
Check whether the query lies inside the characterized range
Flag extrapolation beyond the table edge

label: How good is the fit
subgoals: Compute R squared from the three sums of squares
Inspect residuals for curvature that R squared hides
Prefer held-out error for models used in optimization
